day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Thérèse waseNtwaneni uYesu, Intombi engcwele noGqirha weBandla
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi kunye nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, wena okhanyisela iintliziyo zethu, siqule: Nkosi, sihlangule.
Kristu, wena onguMduduzi wabahedeni, siqule: Kristu, sihlangule.
Nkosi, wena onguLwalwa lwethemba lethu, siqule: Nkosi, sihlangule.
psalm_response: Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona izinto ezintle zeNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu wokuthi cwaka ekhaya, xa ilanga liqala ukutshona, kwaye igumbi elincinci elinendiza ezikhethwe ngobunono eziphezu kweshelfu liqala ukuzala ngomthunzi. Kulo mzuzu, imibuzo engaphendulekiyo iyavela. Kutheni le nto izinto zenzeka ngolu hlobo? Kutheni le nto umntu owayenomdla onjalo, owayefuna ukudala i-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwexesha elizayo, esishiya ngaphambi kokuba siqonde? Namhlanje, kwiSikhumbuzo sikaSaint Thérèse waseNtwaneni uYesu, sijonga indlela yobuntwana obungcwele. UThérèse wayeyazi ukuba ubomi abulinganiswa ngeminyaka, kodwa bubulinganiswa ngobunzulu bothando olunikwayo.

KwiNcwadi kaYobhi, uYobhi uthi: 'Ndiyazi ukuba uMhlanguli wam uyaphila.' La ngamazwi angenakuthelekiswa nanto. UYobhi wayesezintlungwini, ekhala, engaziva ekhuselekile, kodwa ngaphakathi kwelo litye lentlungu, waqonda inyaniso engcwele: ukuba uThixo uyaphila, kwaye uya kubonwa. UYobhi uthi: 'Ngamehlo am, hayi omnye, ndiya kumbona.' Le yimbono kaBenjamin Vo. UBen wayengumfana owayejonga kude, owayejonga phezulu, owayefuna ukubona ubukhulu bukaThixo kwiinkcukacha ezincinci zobomi—kwiindiza, kwiikhowudi, nakuthando olukhulu awayenalo ngabazali bakhe.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthumela abafundi bakhe njengamatakane phakathi kweengcuka. Uthi kubo: 'Ngenani, nithi, uxolo malube kule ndlu.' UYesu uyazi ukuba ubomi bunzima. Uyazi ukuba siphila kwilizwe elinokuziva ngathi liyingcuka. Kodwa uthi: 'Beka uxolo lwakho.' UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

UThérèse waseNtwaneni uYesu wasifundisa 'indlela encinci.' Le ndlela ayikho ekwenzeni izinto ezinkulu eziyothusayo abantu, kodwa ikukwenza izinto ezincinci ngothando olukhulu. UBen wenza kanye oko. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukumamela amabali katata wakhe, owayethanda ukubukela iindiza, owayethanda ukuhleka. Ezi zaziyindlela zakhe zokuthanda uThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Namhlanje, njengoko sijonga iengelosi zinyuka zihla, masikhumbule ukuba uBen uphi na. Uphakathi kwabo, ekhanya, esithanda, esibukele. Masiphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kule Sacrament yothando. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, kwaye ndizimanyanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onguSomandla angasiphathisa uxolo lwakhe, asigcine simelele, asikhokele ngothando lwakhe olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abashiyekileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abazayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike amandla, kwaye abazalise ngethemba elingunaphakade.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: UYobhi wathi: Ndiveleni, ndiveleni, nina bahlobo bam, kuba isandla sikaThixo sindibethile! Kungani na ukuba nindizingele njengokungathi ninguthixo, nindidla ngokungapheliyo? Owu, ngamana amazwi am angabhalwa! Ngamana angashicilelwa kwirekhodi: Ngentsimbi yokukrola nangomkhokeli angakrolwa elityeni ngonaphakade! Kodwa mna, ndiyazi ukuba uMhlanguli wam uyaphila, nokuba ekugqibeleni uya kuma eluthulini; lowo ndiya kumbona mna ngokwam: amehlo am, hayi omnye, aya kumbona, kwaye enyameni yam ndiya kubona uThixo; umphefumlo wam udliwe kukulangazelela.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona izinto ezintle zeNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo. Yiva, Nkosi, isandi sokubiza kwam; ndiveleni, undiphendule. Ngenxa yakho intliziyo yam iyathetha; ubuso bakho obufunwa ngamehlo am. R. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona izinto ezintle zeNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo. Ubuso bakho, Nkosi, endibufunayo. Musa ukufihla ubuso bakho kum; musa ukundigxotha ngomsindo umkhonzi wakho. Ungumncedi wam: musa ukundilahla. R. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona izinto ezintle zeNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona ubutyebi beNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo. Lindela iNkosi ngesibindi; yomelela, ulindele iNkosi. R. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona izinto ezintle zeNkosi kwilizwe labaphilayo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wamisela abanye abafundi abangamashumi asixhenxe anesibini, ababathumela phambi kwakhe ngababini-babini kuyo yonke idolophu nendawo awayeceba ukuyindwendwela. Wathi kubo: 'Isivuno sikhulu, kodwa abasebenzi bambalwa; ngoko ke celani iNkosi yesivuno ukuba ithumele abasebenzi esivunweni sayo. Hambani; khangela, ndinithumela njengamatakane phakathi kweengcuka. Musani ukuphatha ngxowa yemali, nasikhwama, nazimbadada; ningabulisi mntu endleleni. Kuyo nayiphi na indlu eningena kuyo, qala nithi, "Uxolo malube kule ndlu." Ukuba kuhlala umntu onoxolo khona, uxolo lwenu luya kuhlala kuye; kodwa ukuba akunjalo, luya kubuyela kuni. Hlalani kuloo ndlu, nidle nisele oko kunikwayo, kuba umsebenzi ufanele umvuzo wakhe. Musani ukufuduka nindlu ngendlu. Kuyo nayiphi na idolophu eningena kuyo, ukuba banamkela, yidlani oko kubekwe phambi kwenu, niphilise abagulayo kuyo, nithi kubo, "Ubukumkani bukaThixo busondele kuni." Kuyo nayiphi na idolophu eningena kuyo, ukuba abanamkeli, phumani ezitalatweni nithi, "Nothuli lwedolophu yenu olunamathele ezinyaweni zethu, nalo siyaluvuthulula sinichase. Noko ke, yazini oku: Ubukumkani bukaThixo busondele." Ndithi kuni, kuya kubakho ukunyamezeleka ngakumbi kweSodom ngaloo mhla kunokwale dolophu.'

day: Memorial of Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
